name: Proxy Type 3 Code
definition: Specifies the type of proxy person.

CHRM.name: Chairman
CHRM.definition: Chairman of the meeting is the proxy.

DISC.name: Discretionary
DISC.definition: Any type of proxy is allowed.

NEPR.name: Neutral Proxy
NEPR.definition: Neutral proxy nominated by the issuer to execute votes on behalf of investors at the meeting.

HLDR.name: Security Holder
HLDR.definition: Proxy can only be a security holder.
